about: Which requirements of requirements.json flowapi answers for. Edited by hand; read by `cargo run --release --bin report` and `--bin classify` in conformance/ledger/. A rule's `match` is an id or an id prefix ending at a `.`; `*` stands for a version (`oas-*` is oas-3.0, oas-3.1 and oas-3.2). The longest match wins. A rule that fits no id, or an id no rule fits, fails the report. `in-scope` ids end as covered (a `req:` marker in a test) or, once the marker exists, lossy with a reason; `out-of-scope` ids carry the reason a types generator does not answer for them. Serialization (style, explode, allowReserved, encoding, percent-encoding) is the SDK stage's (map FA-012, design.md §10) and out of scope here, since no type depends on it; operations themselves are in scope.
